title: Inland Niger Delta
authors: Department of the Arts of Africa, Oceania, and the Americas, The Metropolitan Museum of Art
version: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Heilbrunn Timeline of Art History

passages.quote: Jenne-jeno (“Old Jenne”; Djenne-jeno), site of the oldest known city of sub-Saharan Africa, was populated as early as 250 B.C. and expanded to become a major urban center by 850 A.D.
Abandoned by 1400, Jenne-jeno left behind tells (settlement mounds) containing the remains of a once-thriving city
